questions.q: Which radiation is stopped by a sheet of paper and is the most strongly ionising?
questions.why: Alpha particles are highly ionising but have very low penetration (stopped by paper or a few cm of air).

questions.q: The count rate from a sample falls from 800 counts/min to 100 counts/min in 6 hours. What is the half-life?
questions.why: 800 → 400 → 200 → 100 is 3 half-lives in 6 hours, so the half-life is 2 hours.

questions.q: A star with about the same mass as the Sun reaches the end of its life. What does it become?
options: a white dwarf and a planetary nebula
questions.why: Small-mass stars: red giant → white dwarf + planetary nebula; supernovae happen only for large-mass stars.

questions.q: The Sun is 1.5 × 10¹¹ m from the Earth. The speed of light is 3.0 × 10⁸ m/s. Calculate the time for light to travel from the Sun to the Earth.
